In [[algebraic topology]], the '''mapping spectrum''' <math>F(X, Y)</math> of [[spectrum (topology)|spectra]] ''X'', ''Y'' is characterized by
:<math>[X \wedge Y, Z] = [X, F(Y, Z)].</math><ref>{{cite web|url=https://mathoverflow.net/q/200422 |title=homology of a mapping spectrum|work=MathOverflow}}</ref>
